title: Tests: wp11_test_backend_fs_dir.c
description: Test suite for the fs-dir backend using a tmpdir as the keystore directory. Cover: empty directory (zero slots), single .p11k file (one slot), multiple files (multiple slots), file added after C_Initialize (inotify path if implemented), corrupted file (graceful skip), PIN verify. Must use independent oracles (known test vectors or cross-validation against soft backend), not the backend as its own oracle.
